source: ERC-2771 replay hazard (documented; OZ MinimalForwarder is the mitigation)
real_flaw: forwarder verifies signature but lacks nonce/domain/seen-hash binding -> meta-tx replayable
flag_gate: recipient faucet drained of >= threshold (N * claimAmount) reward tokens, reachable only by replaying one captured signed meta-tx N times

contracts.RewardToken: OpenZeppelin ERC20 v5.1.0 (stock, fixed-supply mint in constructor)
contracts.Recipient: ERC-2771 context recipient (OZ ERC2771Context v5.1.0); claimReward(amount) pays _msgSender() and is only callable via the trusted forwarder
contracts.NaiveForwarder: ERC-2771 forwarder verifying EIP-712 sig over (from,to,value,gas,deadline,data) with NO nonce, a hardcoded non-address-bound domain and NO seenHash -> captured meta-tx replayable (vulnerable)
contracts.SafeForwarder: ERC-2771 forwarder with EIP-712 domain bound to chainId+address(this), per-signer nonce (OZ Nonces) and seenHash anti-replay (the documented OZ MinimalForwarder mitigation; negative test)
contracts.FlagVault: claim(taskId,flag) gated on rewardToken.balanceOf(recipient) <= recipientInitial - threshold AND keccak256(flag) == expectedHash
